series.summary: Determined not to favor any girlfriend, Rentaro blindfolds himself, but the girls demand his full, honest admiration. Rentaro passionately praises each girl's unique beauty, but when arrogant pickup artists try to hit on them, Hakari and Nano boldly kiss Rentaro in public to claim their man.

segments.description: Rentaro blindfolds himself in panic to avoid staring, but the four girls pull at him demanding his praise.
segments.voiceover_text: Terrified of showing disrespect, Rentaro tries blindfolding himself, but his girlfriends aggressively demand his full, honest admiration.

segments.description: Rentaro delivers heartfelt, rapid-fire compliments to each girl, making Hakari, Karane, Shizuka, and Nano blush.
segments.voiceover_text: Refusing to leave anyone neglected, Rentaro showers each girl with explosive, personalized compliments that leave every single one flustered.

segments.description: The group splashes into the crystal pool water together, laughing and enjoying their date.
segments.voiceover_text: Splashing into the refreshing pool water, the group enjoys an idyllic summer afternoon filled with joyous laughter and mutual affection.

segments.description: Two pushy pickup guys approach the girlfriends trying to flirt, only to be coldly rejected.
segments.voiceover_text: Trouble suddenly brews when arrogant pickup artists try aggressively hitting on the girls, completely oblivious to who they are.

segments.description: Hakari and Nano boldly plant kisses on Rentaro right before the guys, knocking Rentaro completely unconscious with bliss.
segments.voiceover_text: Hakari and Nano silence the intruders by boldly kissing Rentaro in broad daylight, overwhelming him into sweet, blissful unconsciousness.
